subject: Card ink: useInkLayer('flashcard', card.id) + InkSaveStatus; spread canvasProps into InkCanvas keyed by card id
body:
Card ink (S12b) — surface_type `flashcard`, surface_id = `flashcards.id` (uuid string, lowercase). The API 404s a card the student cannot see.

Hook (apps/web/src/ink/persist, landing in the next S12b integrate):

```tsx
import { InkCanvas } from "../ink/InkCanvas";
import { InkSaveStatus, useInkLayer } from "../ink/persist";

const ink = useInkLayer("flashcard", card.id);          // TanStack Query load, Dexie-backed pending map, flush, 30 s refetch
<InkCanvas key={card.id} {...ink.canvasProps} enabled={inkOn} surfaceType="flashcard" label={...} />
<InkSaveStatus layer={ink} />                            // "Saved" / "Saving…" / "Saved on this device · will sync" / "Couldn't save · Retry"
```

- `ink.canvasProps` = `{ items, onStrokesChange, engineRef }` (spread first, then your own props; if you need your own `onStrokesChange` or `engineRef`, pass them to `useInkLayer(type, id, { onStrokesChange, engineRef })` instead so persistence still sees every diff).
- Key the canvas by `card.id`: a new card is a new layer (undo history does not cross cards).
- Until `ink.ready` is true, `items` is undefined and the canvas starts empty; remote items arrive via `engine.applyRemote` without touching undo.
- Nothing to do for the exam/explanation rule on cards: the card front is the surface; put the canvas around the card face you want inked.
